title: Air Fryer Grilled Chicken Tenders
description: Juicy, simply seasoned chicken tenders cooked in the air fryer in about 10 minutes.

items: 2 tbsp light olive oil (or any oil)
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F for 5 minutes.
Toss the chicken with the oil.
Mix the garlic powder, paprika, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper, sprinkle over the chicken and toss until completely coated.
Lay the tenders in the hot basket in a single layer, cooking in two batches if needed.
Cook for 7 minutes, then check. If needed, cook 2–3 minutes more until the chicken reaches 165°F on a digital thermometer.
Serve hot, or chill until ready to use.
